faq.q: What does the Introduction to Applied Microbial Remediation course cover?
faq.a: This course provides restoration professionals with the practical framework to assess microbial amplification events, plan and execute compliant remediation, verify outcomes with measurable evidence, and meet the contractor standards required by insurers and regulatory bodies in Australia.

faq.q: What does the Introduction to Applied Microbial Remediation course help learners understand?
faq.a: Applied microbial remediation is the systematic process of identifying, containing, removing, and verifying the elimination of microbial contamination in built environments.
